description: Statement rules (v2) and rules for any sender: a statement is read before the bill-reminder filter, and a bank's own rules win over rules for any sender.

rules.pattern: Card XX(?<account>\d{4}) statement(?: of (?<statementDate>\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2}))?:\s+min due (?:Rs\.?\s*)?(?<minDue>[\d,.]+),\s+total due (?:Rs\.?\s*)?(?<total>[\d,.]+),\s+pay by (?<dueDate>\d{1,2}-[a-z0-9]{2,3}-\d{2,4})
Payment of Rs\.?\s*(?<amount>[\d,.]+) received on your (?<bank>\w+) Bank card XX(?<account>\d{4})

cases.name: statement: minimum before total, told apart by label
cases.body: Card XX1234 statement: min due Rs.625.00, total due Rs.12,500.00, pay by 5-NOV-26

cases.name: statement with its date, due date in another format
cases.body: Card XX1234 statement of 15-10-26: min due 625, total due 12,500, pay by 05-11-2026

cases.name: a statement the rule can't read is a bill reminder
cases.body: Card XX1234: total due Rs.12,500.00 is due by 05-11-26

cases.name: an unreadable due date isn't a statement
cases.body: Card XX1234 statement: min due Rs.625.00, total due Rs.12,500.00, pay by 05-13-2026

cases.name: a rule for any sender reads a bank no rule names, with the bank from the SMS
cases.body: Payment of Rs.500 received on your Some Bank card XX9876

cases.name: the bank's own rule wins over a rule for any sender
cases.body: Payment of Rs.500 received on your Own Bank card XX9876

cases.name: a rule for any sender doesn't read promotional senders
cases.body: Payment of Rs.500 received on your Some Bank card XX9876

cases.name: an unread SMS takes no bank from a rule for any sender
